text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: What are you having for dinner tonight? I know you're not having lamb chops.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: I'm not a gravy guy, but I enjoy when Jaylen Brown puts gravy on his lamb chops and his gravy's got a little bit of spice to it. Got a little kick to it.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown's conflicting approaches to media narratives
quotes.excerpt: Jayson Tatum is clearly determined to take the high road and Jaylen Brown's like, hell no.
quotes.quote: Jayson Tatum is clearly determined to take the high road and Jaylen Brown's like, hell no. I know a dirt road with some potholes that's muddy right now that I want to take you down. You got me out of town, that's fine, but you ain't just going to act like, oh my gosh, I was so shocked by the deal. No sir. And I love it because they're going to have to deal with each other. They're going to have to deal with each other during the regular season, and they're probably going to have to deal with each other come playoff time.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The gray area of franchise player influence on team trades
quotes.excerpt: Whenever there's a big transaction, there's this gray area of the role that a franchise player has.
quotes.quote: Whenever there's a big transaction, whether it's a coaching transaction or a key player trade, there's this gray area of the role that a franchise player has in it. Sometimes in NBA history, you've seen situations where Kobe Bryant flat out said to the Lakers, it's either me or Shaquille O'Neal. You don't get rid of him, I'm out of here. And then there's been such, like honestly, with the Luka Doncic trade, Kyrie Irving was as blindsided as anybody and his opinion was not consulted. But that was a trade that everybody was shocked by it. This was a trade that basically played out over weeks and weeks. Everybody knew the Celtics were trying to trade Jaylen Brown.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's 'lamb chops and gravy' quote on Jayson Tatum
quotes.excerpt: There's no beef but there might be a little lamb chops with some gravy.
quotes.quote: There's no beef but there might be a little lamb chops with some gravy. He should stay ready at all times. That was a nice, I forgot about that line.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics scheduling and the NBA's focus on LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: The NBA scheduled the Sixers as LeBron's team. The marquee slots for the Sixers were about showcasing LeBron.
quotes.quote: I think the NBA kind of screwed up the scheduling there. I think that should have been there should have been some marquee scheduling slots, but let's just be honest, the NBA scheduled the Sixers as LeBron's team. The marquee slots for the Sixers were about showcasing LeBron, not Jaylen Brown, which I get, but this one's of all the return games, this one's got by far the most salt.
